description: Install a starter template. A pack-shaped template creates its own SPACE; a database-shaped one needs `space` and can be renamed on the way in. Templates seed sample records so the result is not an empty grid — remove_sample_data clears exactly those later, so applying one is not a decision anybody is stuck with.

space.description: Target space, required for a database-shaped template. Never a personal space (documents and views only, 422).

name: apply_template
title: Apply template
